question: Who transmitted the teaching concerning the earth-moving yoginīs who are good eaters?
premises: The subject concerns the earth-moving yoginīs
They are described as good eaters
inference: An earth-moving yoginī transmitted the teaching concerning the earth-moving, good-eating yoginīs.
uncertainties: The instrumental form bhūcarī is read as agent; alternative readings are possible.
plain_english: O beloved, it was told concerning the earth-moving, good-eating yoginīs by an earth-mover.
